messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up: ChauffeurCorp usage down ~60% over 2 weeks. Seats & API calls dipped. New procurement lead Raj Patel started this week; CTO said they're trialing VectorLabs. Looks like a renewal risk. Can we triage quickly?

AJ (Solutions): Checking logs now. Any auth/webhook errors? Looping in @Oliver.

Oliver (Eng): Found repeated 400s + 429s for org_id=98765 on 2025-03-20. Proxy snippets: `{"org_id":"98765","status":"400","path":"/v1/generate","error":"invalid-api-key"}` and `{"org_id":"98765","status":"429","path":"/v1/embeddings","error":"rate_limit"}`. Likely they rotated keys without updating env.

Devon (Sales): Renewal in ~45 days. If CTO is testing a competitor, we need two lanes: restore access fast AND give a perf/demo to stall momentum. I'll pull commercial options.

Maria (CS): Proposed immediate plan:
- Outreach: quick async note to Raj + offer 30-min triage call (AJ + Oliver) today.
- Tech: verify API key and SDK version; Oliver to rotate key if needed.
- Commercial: offer 2-week complimentary dedicated burst as a goodwill/perf proof; Devon to draft.
- Exec: schedule short QBR/demo for CTO highlighting smart routing/fallbacks. I'll schedule.

AJ (Solutions): Drafting checklist for Raj: confirm API key in env matches console, ensure SDK >=1.4.2, run sample request and paste response.

Support Bot: New ticket CH-1129 created: "ChauffeurCorp integration failure: invalid-api-key" https://support.redwood/ch/1129

Maria (CS): Tagging CRM reasons: ["seat_activity_drop","procurement_change","competitive_evaluation"]. Marking renewal flag = at-risk until QBR.

Devon (Sales): Can someone attach last 6mo usage graph (tokens & seats)? I'll draft trial PO + legal language.

Maria (CS): Usage snapshot: https://redwood.screenshots/cc_usage_6m.png

Oliver (Eng): I can rotate their API key and send steps. ETA ~30m.

AJ (Solutions): Booked 45m troubleshooting call with Raj + Eng Manager. Will attach runbook and post-call test script.

Devon (Sales): Drafting trial terms: "2-week dedicated burst, SLA 99.9%, complimentary"  routing to Legal for fast-track.

Maria (CS): Thanks all  please update when CH-1129 resolved and QBR confirmed. I'll create an exec summary for CS leadership. :white_check_mark:
